arithmetic: non-negative checked unsigned 128-bit; any overflow rejects

validation_policy.reason: registry, solver budgets and thresholds are frozen before the request; each outer train reruns the full selector and the outer test honestly evaluates that complete procedure

fit_budget.certificate_rule: one independent certificate for the best reduced start of each branch-expanded structure/cell/direction, not one certificate per start

p2_branch_expansion.balanced_cells_formula: count j in [0,g_scope-2] such that ceil(0.40*n_scope) <= cumulative_rows_through_sorted_x_group[j] <= floor(0.60*n_scope); every raw-binary64 equal-x group is atomic
p2_branch_expansion.balanced_cells_accounting: before solver, enumerate the exact canonical group-size vector separately for full data, every frozen outer-training scope and every leave-one-group influence scope; forecast all balance-valid gaps even when later family support/rank checks will reject them

llm_start_advisor.call_count_formula: if enabled: 1 + R*K (full-data plus every outer-training registry scope); influence, bootstrap and predictor make no calls
llm_start_advisor.p1_replaceable_slots: for each nonlinear structure keep every anchor and replace at most the final one of 3 starts or final two of 5 starts
llm_start_advisor.p2_replaceable_slots: per structure/cell/direction keep every anchor and replace at most the final one of 3 starts or final two of 5 starts
llm_start_advisor.invalid_or_missing_response: use the exact deterministic start originally assigned to that slot
llm_start_advisor.admission_rule: advisor calls and reserved bytes are added before any network/solver activity; they never increase fit-attempt, evaluation or certificate budgets

task_graph.construction: materialize the complete deterministic DAG before the first solver call from rows, canonical x-groups, fixed outer splits, registry branches, starts, OOF bootstrap seeds and selected-structure LGO budgets
task_graph.fit_scopes: one full-data P1/P2 registry scope plus R*K outer-training P1/P2 registry scopes; there are no inner fit scopes
task_graph.bootstrap: 200 aggregation-only nodes resample canonical x-group IDs and sum frozen paired OOF loss contributions; no fitting, selection or prediction occurs
task_graph.bootstrap_work_formula: 8*sum(selected OOF appearances including multiplicity) over all 200 resamples
task_graph.influence: for every canonical x-group, refit only the selected full-data P1 structure and selected P2 family-pair/direction across all remaining balanced boundary cells; do not rerun registry selection, validation, bootstrap or recommendation
task_graph.task_nodes_formula: all fit-attempt and certificate nodes plus the enumerated non-fit nodes
task_graph.work_units_formula: all frozen objective/certificate work plus 8 units per paired OOF metric appearance, 8 per selected bootstrap appearance and 4 per model/grid influence comparison
task_graph.actual_accounting: each executed node records actual objective evaluations and row-equivalent units; actual values must not exceed its frozen node budget or the run fails WORK_ACCOUNTING_EXCEEDED

workdir_forecast.identifier_replication_bound: 3*input_snapshot_bytes*(2*repetitions+4) reserves worst-case UTF-8 percent expansion for both procedure rows in every OOF repetition plus observations, plot/report and one spare identifier-bearing copy; fixed per-row syntax remains in per-row terms
workdir_forecast.writer_rule: every writer reserves against the forecast and refuses before an append that would exceed it; actual retained workdir bytes must not exceed forecast

demo_forecast.oracle: each value is independently recomputed by audit_acceptance.py from this policy and the frozen demo; every value is below its production limit

demo_advisor_enabled_forecast.oracle: the advisor substitutes existing starts, so solver work is unchanged; call nodes, one trace publication node and 98304 reserved bytes per call are added and remain below production limits

boundary_acceptance.exact_limit: a test-only signed policy copy sets one guard equal to the independently recomputed forecast and must admit
boundary_acceptance.limit_plus_one: the same copy sets that guard to forecast-1 and must reject before solver; production limits and request are otherwise byte-identical
boundary_acceptance.checked_overflow: synthetic maximal counts overflow the checked formula and reject before solver
boundary_acceptance.policy_mutation_scope: test-only admission oracle; it cannot be supplied by the public CLI and never changes a fitted result
